name: select
title: Select
description: Accessible dropdown selector built on reka-ui, with groups, labels, separators and scroll buttons.
docs: Bind Select with v-model and v-model:open when needed. Every SelectItem must receive a non-empty value string because empty strings clear the selection and show the placeholder. Set invalid on SelectTrigger for validation errors.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectRoot } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SelectProps = {
  /** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  name?: string
  required?: boolean
  autocomplete?: string
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SelectProps>(), {
  defaultValue: undefined,
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  disabled: false,
  name: undefined,
  required: false,
  autocomplete: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<string>()
const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
</script>

<template>
  <SelectRoot
    v-model="model"
    v-model:open="open"
    :default-value="defaultValue"
    :default-open="defaultOpen"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :name="name"
    :required="required"
    :autocomplete="autocomplete"
    v-bind="$attrs"
  >
    <slot />
  </SelectRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SelectIcon, SelectTrigger } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  delete rest['aria-invalid']
  return rest
})

export type SelectTriggerProps = {
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Marks the control as invalid and paints the border with the danger colour. */
  invalid?: boolean
  id?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectTriggerProps>(), {
  disabled: false,
  invalid: false,
  id: undefined,
})

const ariaInvalid = computed(() => {
  if (props.invalid) return 'true'
  return attrs['aria-invalid'] as 'true' | 'false' | 'grammar' | 'spelling' | undefined
})
</script>

<template>
  <SelectTrigger
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :id="id"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :aria-invalid="ariaInvalid"
    :class="
      cn(
        'inline-flex h-11 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-control border border-line bg-control px-3 text-[15px] text-ink',
        'data-[placeholder]:text-ink-muted [&>span]:line-clamp-1',
        'outline-none focus-visible:border-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
        'aria-[invalid=true]:border-danger aria-[invalid=true]:focus-visible:outline-danger',
        'disabled:cursor-default disabled:opacity-55',
        'transition-[background-color,color,border-color,outline-color,box-shadow] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-normal)] ease-out-expo motion-reduce:transition-none',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
    <SelectIcon as-child>
      <slot name="icon">
        <svg
          class="size-4 shrink-0 text-ink-muted"
          viewBox="0 0 16 16"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="1.75"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4" />
        </svg>
      </slot>
    </SelectIcon>
  </SelectTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectValue } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SelectValueProps = {
  placeholder?: string
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SelectValueProps>(), {
  placeholder: undefined,
})
</script>

<template>
  <SelectValue v-if="$slots.default" v-slot="slotProps" :placeholder="placeholder" v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </SelectValue>
  <SelectValue v-else :placeholder="placeholder" v-bind="$attrs" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import {
  SelectContent,
  SelectPortal,
  SelectScrollDownButton,
  SelectScrollUpButton,
  SelectViewport,
} from 'reka-ui'
import { selectSurface } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SelectContentProps = {
  position?: 'popper' | 'item-aligned'
  side?: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'
  sideOffset?: number
  align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectContentProps>(), {
  position: 'popper',
  side: 'bottom',
  sideOffset: 6,
  align: 'start',
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SelectPortal>
    <SelectContent
      v-bind="forwarded"
      :position="props.position"
      :side="props.side"
      :side-offset="props.sideOffset"
      :align="props.align"
      :class="cn(selectSurface, attrs.class as ClassValue)"
    >
      <SelectScrollUpButton
        class="flex cursor-default items-center justify-center py-1 text-ink-muted"
      >
        <svg
          class="size-3.5"
          viewBox="0 0 16 16"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="1.75"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="m4 10 4-4 4 4" />
        </svg>
      </SelectScrollUpButton>
      <SelectViewport
        :class="
          cn(
            'p-1.5',
            props.position === 'popper' &&
              'h-[var(--reka-select-trigger-height)] w-full min-w-[var(--reka-select-trigger-width)]',
          )
        "
      >
        <slot />
      </SelectViewport>
      <SelectScrollDownButton
        class="flex cursor-default items-center justify-center py-1 text-ink-muted"
      >
        <svg
          class="size-3.5"
          viewBox="0 0 16 16"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="1.75"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4" />
        </svg>
      </SelectScrollDownButton>
    </SelectContent>
  </SelectPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { SelectGroup } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })
</script>

<template>
  <SelectGroup v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </SelectGroup>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SelectLabel } from 'reka-ui'
import { selectLabel } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SelectLabel v-bind="forwarded" :class="cn(selectLabel, attrs.class as ClassValue)">
    <slot />
  </SelectLabel>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SelectSeparator } from 'reka-ui'
import { selectSeparator } from './styles'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <SelectSeparator v-bind="forwarded" :class="cn(selectSeparator, attrs.class as ClassValue)" />
</template>

export const selectSurface = [
  'z-50 max-h-80 min-w-[8rem] overflow-hidden rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised text-ink shadow-popup outline-none',
  'origin-[var(--reka-select-content-transform-origin)]',
  'data-[side=bottom]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:-4px]',
  'data-[side=top]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:4px]',
  'data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:4px] data-[side=left]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
  'data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-x:-4px] data-[side=right]:[--p0seid0n-pop-y:0px]',
  'motion-safe:animate-pop-in data-[state=closed]:motion-safe:animate-pop-out',
].join(' ')

export const selectItem = [
  'relative flex h-9 cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] px-3',
  'text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-muted outline-none',
  'transition-[background-color,color] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-fast)] ease-out-expo motion-reduce:transition-none',
  'hover:bg-control hover:text-ink',
  'focus:bg-control focus:text-ink',
  'data-[highlighted]:bg-control data-[highlighted]:text-ink',
  'data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-55',
].join(' ')

export const selectLabel = 'px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium text-ink-faint'

export const selectSeparator = 'my-1 h-px bg-line'

export { default as Select } from './Select.vue'
export { default as SelectTrigger } from './SelectTrigger.vue'
export { default as SelectValue } from './SelectValue.vue'
export { default as SelectContent } from './SelectContent.vue'
export { default as SelectGroup } from './SelectGroup.vue'
export { default as SelectItem } from './SelectItem.vue'
export { default as SelectLabel } from './SelectLabel.vue'
export { default as SelectSeparator } from './SelectSeparator.vue'

export type { SelectProps } from './Select.vue'
export type { SelectTriggerProps } from './SelectTrigger.vue'
export type { SelectValueProps } from './SelectValue.vue'
export type { SelectContentProps } from './SelectContent.vue'
export type { SelectItemProps } from './SelectItem.vue'
